decision.rationale: The saved official Mining Engineering homepage primarily presents undergraduate and graduate engineering education. It also explicitly describes institute research and separately labels news and events.
evidence: https://mining.ubc.ca/ | c2fbe701f748fd67e685020f53d3cdf278775ce93432ceefee2b04171223b26b | Mining at UBC offers a broad professional degree integrating engineering, earth and mineral sciences, safety, environmental issues, social sciences, management and economics.
https://mining.ubc.ca/ | c2fbe701f748fd67e685020f53d3cdf278775ce93432ceefee2b04171223b26b | The Institute conducts cutting-edge research across disciplines related to the mining industry.
https://mining.ubc.ca/ | c2fbe701f748fd67e685020f53d3cdf278775ce93432ceefee2b04171223b26b | The homepage separately labels News and Events and links /news and /events.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly identifies institute research as a distinct academic activity.
The homepage explicitly labels /news and its dated entries as institute news.
The homepage's event section provides opportunities to attend institute activities.

fallback.rationale: Undergraduate and graduate Mining Engineering programs, curriculum and academic community.
